assumptions.choice: Use signal bar close price (self.data.close[0]) as EntryPrice for size and bracket price calculation.
assumptions.reason: The exact entry price for market execution is not known at signal calculation time; close price serves as the deterministic reference.

assumptions.choice: Apply Monday/Wednesday/Friday rule specifically to new trade entry evaluation.
assumptions.reason: Position exits via bracket limits/stops or lower band crossover execute when conditions trigger regardless of day of week.

assumptions.choice: Capture initial cash balance at strategy start() and use it for all fixed risk size calculations.
assumptions.reason: Specification explicitly disables reinvestment and mandates using initial capital across all trade calculations.
